dataset.name: c2_middle_east_multi_source_en
dataset.note: Simulated data for training and system test. Not real intelligence. English-only edition: all field values have been translated to English; native-language originals have been removed.

standards.grid_reference: MGRS, WGS84, 10 m precision, computed from coordinates
standards.vessel_identity: IMO number with valid ISO 6346-style check digit
standards.time: All times UTC (Zulu). DTG per NATO convention.

pir_register.PIR-01: Indicators of maritime interdiction or attack against merchant shipping
pir_register.PIR-02: Sanctions-evasion activity: STS transfers, AIS manipulation, reflagging
pir_register.PIR-03: Anti-ship missile, UAS and USV deployment near the littoral
pir_register.PIR-04: Air-defence coverage affecting coalition air operations
pir_register.PIR-05: Illicit weapons transhipment through regional ports
pir_register.PIR-06: Force posture changes by non-state armed groups in the coastal belt

changes_from_v2: Admiralty codes rebuilt: source reliability and information credibility separated; sensor technology moved out of the evaluation field.
GPS spoofing records no longer carry high positional confidence; the spoofed AIS fix is retained separately and flagged unusable.
All timestamps moved into a valid past window; none post-date generation.
Vessel registry expanded from 6 to 48 hulls with valid IMO check digits.
Iranian flag replaced by realistic open-registry reflagging patterns.
MGRS computed from coordinates rather than invented.
Classification and handling caveats applied to every record.
HUMINT reporting in native languages with translation metadata.
OSINT text bank expanded from 9 templates to 45.
Single jurisdiction per location; maritime zone made explicit.
Observation/report time separated to expose reporting latency.
Cross-source correlation computed; credibility 1 requires corroboration.
changes_from_v3_multilingual: OSINT non-English records: native title and text replaced by their English translations.
HUMINT non-English records: native text_original field removed; English text retained.
Translation metadata fields (translation_status, text_language, text_original_language) removed.
